_comment: Mock BioNeMo NIM variant-effect outputs. Keyed by rsID first, then by GENE. Anything unknown falls back to a deterministic hash-derived score so an arbitrary uploaded VCF still runs.

rs121913529.notes: Activating KRAS codon-12 substitution. Constitutive downstream MAPK signalling independent of EGFR; established predictor of non-response to anti-EGFR antibodies in colorectal cancer.
rs121913529.therapy_implication: anti-EGFR (cetuximab, panitumumab) not expected to be effective

rs3918290.notes: DPYD*2A splice-donor loss-of-function allele. Carriers have markedly reduced dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase activity and severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity at standard doses.
rs3918290.therapy_implication: 5-FU / capecitabine dose reduction indicated (CPIC: 50% starting dose for heterozygotes)

rs1801133.notes: Common MTHFR C677T polymorphism, allele frequency ~30% in European ancestry. Reduced enzyme thermolability in vitro; clinical association with fluoropyrimidine outcome is inconsistent across studies.

rs28934578.notes: Hotspot TP53 DNA-binding-domain substitution with dominant-negative behaviour. Prognostic in colorectal cancer; not directly predictive of anti-EGFR response.

APC.notes: Synonymous change with no predicted splice effect.
